task.title: TG /vibecode: bat VPN tren may Windows + kiem tra do on dinh cua app
task.detail: Nguyen van chu du an (bus #600, owner -> win, 2026-09-30T05:32:01Z): 'bat vpn tren may win len, kiem tra do on dinh cua app.' Pham vi: (1) dam bao VPNFlow (PrivateVPNWindows.App) dang bat va tunnel vpnflow (WireGuard 10.77.0.57) len; (2) do do on dinh: mat goi, do tre, DNS, handshake WireGuard, uptime/crash cua app; ghi bang chung len docs/evidence.
